description: vCard (.vcf) parser — Parse vCard 2.1/3.0/4.0 contact files into clean JSON: names, organization, title, emails (validated), phones (E.164 when determinable, extensions), addresses (formatted), URLs, IM handles, birthday/anniversary (ISO, year-less dates), gender, notes, categories, geo, photo info, UID/REV and unknown X- properties. Handles line folding, quoted-printable + charsets, escapes, grouped properties and multiple cards per file. Flags missing FN/N/VERSION, invalid emails, suspect phones, unclosed cards, and possible duplicate contacts (same email, phone or name). Input vcard= (text) or url= (.vcf link, max 2 MB). Optional format=json|jcard|csv (jcard = RFC 7095; csv = spreadsheet-ready contact export), country=US (default NANP for 10-digit numbers), max= (contacts returned, default 500). Offline. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).

EMAIL;TYPE=PREF,INTERNET:forrestgump@example.com
ADR;TYPE=WORK:;;100 Waters Edge;Baytown;LA;30314;USA
BDAY:1944-06-06
END:VCARD

name: util_vcard
